5189805: What Our Lord Saw from the Cross is an watercolor painting by the French painter James Tissot, from c. 1890.
What Our Lord Saw from the Cross
7763918: The Shop Girl is an oil on canvas painting by French artist James Tissot, from 1883-1885. It is in the Art Gallery of Ontario, in Toronto.
17189312: The Gallery of HMS 'Calcutta' (Portsmouth), also known as Officer and Ladies on Board HMS Calcutta, is an 1876 oil painting by the French artist James Tissot.
17190953: Portrait of Mademoiselle L.L. is an oil painting on canvas by the French artist James Tissot, from 1864. It depicts a young woman wearing a red bolero jacket seated on a small table.
17493677: The Two Sisters is an oil painting on canvas by the French artist James Tissot, from 1863.
19858217: Saint Joseph Seeks a Lodging at Bethlehem is an opaque watercolor painting over graphite by French artist James Tissot. The painting was created between 1886–1894, near the end of his career.
Saint Joseph Seeks a Lodging at Bethlehem
19886741: Japanese Girl Bathing is an oil painting on canvas by the French artist James Tissot, from 1864. It features a young Japanese nude woman bathing.
19912015: Tea is a mid-19th century painting by French artist James Tissot. Done in oil on wood, the painting depicts a scene in which a young woman reacts to word that a captain is departing.
20416827: An Interesting Story is an oil on panel genre painting by the French artist James Tissot, from 1872. It is held at the National Gallery of Victoria, in Melbourne.
28050264: Portrait of Frederick Burnaby is an oil on panel portrait painting by the French artist James Tissot from 1870. It depicts the British army officer and celebrity Frederick Burnaby.
28537468: Holyday, later also known as The Picnic, is an oil painting by French painter James Tissot (1836–1902), painted in 1876. The composition is set in the artist’s garden in the wealthy north London suburb of St John’s Wood.
28537752: Portsmouth Dockyard is an oil painting on canvas by French artist James Tissot, from 1877. It is a reworking of his 1876 painting On The Thames, which also depicts a man and two women in a boat.
28538905: The Ball on Shipboard is an oil painting on canvas by the French artist James Tissot, from 1874. It is held at the Tate Britain, in London.
46941154: Young Women Looking at Japanese Articles is an oil painting on canvas by the French artist James Tissot, from 1869.
Young Women Looking at Japanese Articles
64510834: The Two Friends is an 1881 oil painting by the French artist James Tissot. It depicts the farewell between two male friends shaking hands as they part, one of them aboard a ship about to make a Transatlantic crossing.
78692958: London Visitors is an oil on canvas genre painting by the French artist James Tissot, from 1874.
87742945: Hush! is an oil painting on canvas by the French artist James Tissot, from 1875.
88022399: The Convalescent is an oil painting on canvas by the French artist James Tissot, from 1876.
90598783: The Captain's Daughter is an oil painting on canvas by the French artist James Tissot, from 1873.
90735813: The Farewells is an oil on canvas genre painting by the French artist James Tissot, from 1871.
90845010: The Last Evening is an oil painting on canvas by the French artist James Tissot, from 1873. It shows a scene set aboard a ship, but it is unclear exactly the context or the relationship between the various figures.
90845013: Too Early is an oil on canvas genre painting by the French artist James Tissot, from 1873.
91135841: The Bridesmaid is a c.1885 oil painting by the French artist James Tissot. It depicts an attractive young bridesmaid being helped into a carriage by a groomsman in a bustling Paris street as passers-by turn to look at her.
115612256: Waiting for the Ferry at the Falcon Tavern is an oil on canvas genre painting by the French artist James Tissot, from 1874. It is held at the Speed Art Museum, in Louisville.
